name: Universal-Billing-System-V4.2
description: Universal Billing System v5.0 is a secure Flask-based invoicing app with admin and staff login, PDF bill generation, QR receipts, Excel-backed bill/return tracking, audit logging, store settings, and configurable session timeout. It supports item returns, exportable data, and simple desktop startup. Easy local install, secure sessions preview plus!

paragraphs: A secure, offline billing and invoice system with fixed bugs and glitches built with Flask and Excel. This project provides a desktop-friendly billing dashboard with PDF bill generation, QR codes, item returns, audit logging, admin controls, and configurable store settings.
features: Admin and staff login with role-based access
Create bills with live preview, item-level discount, and automatic totals
Generate printable PDF invoices with QR code receipts
Store bills in storebills.xlsx with separate sheets for Bills, Returns, Profit/Loss, and Settings
Process item returns and track return history

whatItDoes.text: A secure, offline billing and invoice system with fixed bugs and glitches built with Flask and Excel. This project provides a desktop-friendly billing dashboard with PDF bill generation, QR codes, item returns, audit logging, admin controls, and configurable store settings.

requirements.text: Admin and staff login with role-based access
> Change the credentials after the first login for a production deployment.
